findings.description: The code performs unchecked type casts from read() return values to enum types without validation.
The code doesn't check if I2C operations succeed.
The i2c_dev pointer is used without null checking.
No validation of data read from hardware registers before casting to specific enum types.
No error handling for I2C communication failures.
